role.zh-CN: 阿尔卑斯与南半球雪场路书编辑
role.en: Alps & Southern Hemisphere Ski Trailbook Editor

bio.zh-CN: 常驻法国萨瓦省与瑞士瓦莱州九个雪季，持有法国高山双板教学与山地安全协作资质，长期实地复核瑞士、法国、奥地利、意大利跨国联票铁路接驳，以及中亚天山与南半球反季雪场住滑线路。
bio.en: Based between Savoie and Valais across nine winter seasons with French alpine ski instruction credentials, auditing rail-to-lift connections, cross-border passes, and mountain stays across the Alps, Tien Shan, and the Southern Hemisphere.
